Bar B Q Lamb
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:06am

Ingredients




1 leg of lamb, have butcher butterfly
1/2 cup olive oil
1/4 cup lemon juice
5 cloves garlic, crushed
1 onion, sliced thin
2 bay leaves
Fresh black pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Place meat in shallow dish, pour oil and lemon juice over it. Spread on crushed garlic. Add onion rings, thyme, bay leaves and pepper. Marinate a minimum of 4 hours. Bar B Q on outside grill.
